description: Structured output schema for Codex exploration reports. Used with codex exec --output-schema.

status.description: COMPLETE: every numbered question answered. PARTIAL: some answered; rest in open_questions. BLOCKED: could not investigate; reason in open_questions.

summary.description: 3-6 sentence synthesis of the most important findings, written for the reviewer.

findings.description: One entry per numbered question in the brief, in order.

question.description: The brief question, verbatim or by number.

answer.description: Direct answer. Facts only; no speculation beyond the stated confidence.

evidence.description: Repo-relative file:line references backing the answer.

confidence.description: certain: verified by reading the code. likely: strong indication, not fully traced. unsure: lead only — weak or no evidence.

open_questions.description: What could not be answered and why, plus anything discovered that the reviewer should know.
